attempts.text:
{"test_cases": [
    {"id": "TC1", "title": "Test setting a new password that meets all AC1, AC2, AC3, and AC4 requirements", "type": "positive", "preconditions": "User is logged in and on the account page", "steps": [
        "User enters a password that is 8 characters long and contains at least one uppercase letter, one lowercase letter, one digit, and one special character.",
        "User enters a new password that is not the same as the current password or any password the user has used before.",
        "User types the password while the checklist shows the rules not met yet.",
        "User confirms the password change and sees the message 'Password updated'."
    ], "expected_result": "Password is updated successfully and the user sees the message 'Password updated'.", "covers": ["AC1", "AC2", "AC3", "AC4"]},
    {"id": "TC2", "title": "Test setting a password that is too short", "type": "negative", "preconditions": "User is logged in and on the account page", "steps": [
        "User enters a password that is less than 8 characters long.",
        "User tries to confirm the password change."
    ], "expected_result": "The page shows 'You cannot reuse a recent password' because the password does not meet AC1.", "covers": ["AC1"]},
    {"id": "TC3", "title": "Test setting a password that is too long", "type": "negative", "preconditions": "User is logged in and on the account page", "steps": [
        "User enters a password that is more than 64 characters long.",
        "User tries to confirm the password change."
    ], "expected_result": "The page shows 'You cannot reuse a recent password' because the password does not meet AC1.", "covers": ["AC1"]},
    {"id": "TC4", "title": "Test setting a password that does not contain a digit", "type": "negative", "preconditions": "User is logged in and on the account page", "steps": [
        "User enters a password that contains only uppercase and lowercase letters and a special character.",
        "User tries to confirm the password change."
    ], "expected_result": "The page shows 'You cannot reuse a recent password' because the password does not meet AC2.", "covers": ["AC2"]},
    {"id": "TC5", "title": "Test setting a password that does not contain a special character", "type": "negative", "preconditions": "User is logged in and on the account page", "steps": [
        "User enters a password that contains only uppercase and lowercase letters and digits.",
        "User tries to confirm the password change."
    ], "expected_result": "The page shows 'You cannot reuse a recent password' because the password does not meet AC2.", "covers": ["AC2"]},
    {"id": "TC6", "title": "Test setting a password that does not contain an uppercase letter", "type": "negative", "preconditions": "User is logged in and on the account page", "steps": [
        "User enters a password that contains only lowercase letters, digits, and special characters.",
        "User tries to confirm the password change."
    ], "expected_result": "The page shows 'You cannot reuse a recent password' because the password does not meet AC2.", "covers": ["AC2"]},
    {"id": "TC7", "title": "Test setting a password that does not contain a lowercase letter", "type": "negative", "preconditions": "User is logged in and on the account page", "steps": [
        "User enters a password that contains only uppercase letters, digits, and special characters.",
        "User tries to confirm the password change."
    ], "expected_result": "The page shows 'You cannot reuse a recent password' because the password does not meet AC2.", "covers": ["AC2"]},
    {"id": "TC8", "title": "Test setting a password that does not contain a digit", "type": "negative", "preconditions": "User is logged in and on the account page", "steps": [
        "User enters a password that contains only uppercase and lowercase letters and special characters.",
        "User tries to confirm the password change."
    ], "expected_result": "The page shows 'You cannot reuse a recent password' because the password does not meet AC2.", "covers": ["AC2"]},
    {"id": "TC9", "title": "Test setting a password that does not contain a special character", "type": "negative", "preconditions": "User is logged in and on the account page", "steps": [
        "User enters a password that contains only uppercase and lowercase letters and digits.",
        "User tries to confirm the password change."
    ], "expected_result": "The page shows 'You cannot reuse a recent password' because the password does not meet AC2.", "covers": ["AC2"]},
    {"id": "TC10", "title": "Test setting a password that is the same as the current password", "type": "negative", "preconditions": "User is logged in and on the account page", "steps": [
        "User enters the same password as the current password.",
        "User tries to confirm the password change."
    ], "expected_result": "The page shows 'You cannot reuse a recent password' because the password does not meet AC3.", "covers": ["AC3"]}
]}
